question: If ‘P’ stands for ‘÷’, ‘Q’ stands for ‘×’, ‘R’ stands for ‘+’ and ‘S’ stands for ‘−’, then the resultant of which of the following would be 38?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/952c967501c582f1911db7fefdaaefa9b6e3f505512624eb925e04e002be5a1f.png]

**Required resultant:** 38

So, checking each option one by one:

Option 1) 32 S 8 R 30 Q 16 P 4 ⇒ 32 - 8 + 30 × 16 ÷ 4
